page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance features 4 vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with dedicated hypervisor allocation, paired with 16.0 GB of RAM. The x86_64 architecture incorporates instruction set extensions including AVX-512, VNNI, BFLOAT16, and AES cryptography capabilities. It includes 32 MB of L3 cache, operates under the KVM hypervisor, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. Local disk storage is not bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-core compute performance, placing in the top 25% in stress-ng single-core tests. Multi-core compute performance and PassMark CPU metrics fall within the middle 50% range, alongside average single-threaded compression speeds. However, performance tests reveal lower efficiency in multi-threaded decompression, PassMark database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving, where results fall into the bottom 25%.

Lacking bundled ephemeral disk storage and showing lower relative database throughput, the instance relies on remote network storage for persistent operational data. Its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and solid single-core processing capabilities make it suitable for lightweight general-purpose workloads, microservices, and development tasks that prioritize single-thread CPU performance over high-concurrency web-serving throughput.
